Part 1 |enva=[[Alyson Leigh Rosenfeld|Alyson Rosenfeld]] |java=[[Eri Kitamura]] |gameanim=yes |envagame=Brianna Knickerbocker[https://twitter.com/briannanoellek/status/1166945791404937216 Brianna Knickerbocker on Twitter] ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) |javagame=Chisa Suganuma[https://twitter.com/s_schisa/status/1167359430024781824 Chisa Suganuma on Twitter] (Japanese) ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) |pv=yes |pvnum=GOTCHA! |pvname=GOTCHA! }} '''Roxie''' (Japanese: '''ホミカ''' ''Homika'') is a {{wp|musician}} who is the [[Gym Leader]] of [[Virbank City]]'s [[Gym]], known officially as the [[Virbank Gym]]. She [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Poison}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. She gives the {{Badge|Toxic}} to Trainers who defeat her. ==In the core series games== Roxie appears in {{B2W2}} as a Gym Leader. She is a musician who plays the {{wp|bass guitar}}. Her Gym is a music club. Trainers who defeat Roxie will receive the Toxic Badge, along with {{TM|09|Venoshock}}. Before the Gym battle, Roxie is seen in Virbank City outside of the Pokémon Center, arguing with her father about him becoming a movie star. He defends his wishes by commenting that Roxie balances her duties as the Virbank Gym Leader, and as a member of her rock band. He leaves, and Roxie gets angry and heads for the Gym, which the {{player}} can directly challenge. After the Gym battle, Roxie can be seen near the port with Hugh and several of the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s. After the battle that follows, she gives the player {{HM|01|Cut}} and then heads back to the Gym. Roxie later makes a brief appearance after the player competes in the [[Pokémon World Tournament]] for the first time, expressing an interest in competing in it (causing Clay to remark that word of the competition is spreading). Roxie does indeed compete in it later, along with most other Gym Leaders. {{color2|fff|Pokémon Black and White Versions 2|Black 2 and White 2}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Roxie/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Roxie anime.png|thumb|250px|Roxie in {{aniseries|BW}}]] ====''Pokémon the Series: Black & White''==== Roxie appeared in ''[[BW083|Rocking the Virbank Gym! Part 1]]'' and ''[[BW084|Part 2]]''. Like the {{pkmn|games}}, she is a musician who plays the bass guitar. She fronts [[Unova]]'s top punk rock band named "Koffing and the Toxics", with {{tc|Roughneck}} {{un|Nicky}} and {{tc|Guitarist}} [[Billy Jo]] as the other members. She is also a powerful [[Gym Leader]], defeating everyone who dared to challenge her with only three Pokémon even when they challenged her with six. When {{Ash}} arrived at her Gym, she was thrilled to see his {{AP|Pikachu}}, as she too had a Pokémon originating from [[Kanto]], {{p|Koffing}}, and happily accepted his challenge. Roxie defeated five out of six of Ash's Pokémon, except for Pikachu, who knocked out Roxie's {{p|Garbodor}}. When she was defeated, she happily congratulated Ash as the crowd cheered for his victory, and she presented him with his eighth and final [[Unova]] Badge, the {{Badge|Toxic}}. She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]''. ====[[Pokémon movie]]s==== Roxie also made a cameo appearance in the ending credits of ''[[M16|Genesect and the Legend Awakened]]''. ====Character==== Roxie is brimming with confidence. She is determined to prove her strength against all challengers, with the [[Virbank Gym]]'s unique rules giving the challenger the opportunity to use up to six Pokémon against Roxie's three. Her usual battle strategy is to {{status|poison}} her opponent's Pokémon before dealing damage with some heavy-hitting attacks. She is highly perceptive and has developed counter strategies to take out her challengers in quick succession. Roxie proved herself to be a very capable [[Gym Leader]], defeating five of {{Ash}}'s six Pokémon despite being at a disadvantage in terms of her [[party]]. She would occasionally perform a riff on her bass during the battle, and the crowd would chant her name. Despite their status as opponents, she also preferred giving Ash a fairer chance, offering {{AP|Pignite}} a [[Pecha Berry]] to heal its poisoning after it defeated {{p|Scolipede}} when she could have simply let the battle continue with Pignite weakening. ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Roxie's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké | trainer = Roxie | pkmn = Koffing | type1 = Poison | epnum = BW083 | epname = Rocking the Virbank Gym! Isatxa Mengíbar ([[BW103]])}} ===GOTCHA!=== Roxie briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== ===={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}==== [[File:Roxie Marlon Adventures.png|thumb|270px|Roxie in Pokémon Adventures]] Roxie was first mentioned by {{adv|Yuko}} in ''[[PS530|Movie Panic]]'', where she debuted in ''[[PS533|New Sword Player]]''. After attending one of her concerts, {{adv|Blake}} asked Roxie to be a judge at the [[Aspertia City]] [[Pokémon academy|Trainers' School]] [[Autumn Choir Tournament]], which she happily accepted. In ''[[PS534|Choir Tournament]]'', after Blake's team won the competition, Roxie had [[Pop Roxie|her father]] take the winning team and their class to [[Castelia City]] to compete in the Unova Choir Tournament. In ''[[PS535|Angry Boy]]'', shortly after arriving at their destination, Roxie encountered an injured member of the executive committee for the Unova Choir Tournament. When the man revealed his {{p|Karrablast}} was stolen by [[Team Plasma]], Roxie, Blake, {{adv|Whitley}}, and [[Hugh]] headed to the [[Castelia Sewers]] to find the culprits. Soon after entering the area, everyone was attacked by a group of {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s. Roxie and Whitley were separated from the others, but they managed to defeat the Grunts, forcing them to retreat. In ''[[PS538|Therian Forme III]]'', Roxie and Whitley left the sewers to meet with the others at Prime Pier. Whitley stayed behind while Roxie went ahead to return the executive committee member's Karrablast. Hugh appeared and revealed to everyone that a student was a member of Team Plasma, forcing Whitley to come out of hiding and reveal herself. Finding her behavior suspicious, Roxie and the class began to suspect Whitley, but were put to sleep by her [[Foongy]]'s spores. In ''[[PS541|Pink Slip]]'', {{adv|Cheren}} woke up to find he, Roxie, and the class were taken to the [[Marine Tube]]. There, they encountered [[Benga]], a Trainers' School student that was suspended on the first day of school for picking a fight with his classmates. Benga and [[Marlon]] took everyone to safety after Castelia was frozen over by Team Plasma's flying ship, the [[Plasma Frigate]]. When asked to join Benga and Marlon launch a counterattack against the villains, Roxie and Cheren agreed. In ''[[PS548|Epilogue]]'', Roxie attended the Trainers' School graduation ceremony. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Roxie |pkmn=Whirlipede |type1=Bug |type2=Poison |img=Roxie Whirlipede Adventures.png |epnum=PS535 |epname=Angry Boy |desc={{p|Whirlipede}} is Roxie's only known Pokémon. During the middle of the battle, [[Bianca]] recognized Roxie as a singer and Trainer from [[Virbank City]]. Roxie confirmed her talents to Arata and doesn't sense the heart in him to become a Pokémon Trainer. After Arata protected {{p|Oshawott}} from a falling light pole, Oshawott was able to defeat Roxie.
